hero.label: Hero
hero.description: A big centred headline, two buttons and the product below

hero-split.label: Hero, split

statement.label: Statement

logos.label: Logos

text.label: Text section

updates.label: Updates

list.label: List

features.label: Features

stats.label: Numbers
stats.description: Four large figures with a line of text each

testimonials.label: Testimonials
testimonials.description: One big quote, then three smaller ones

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.description: Three plans, the popular one on a dark card

faq.label: FAQ
faq.description: A title beside questions that open to show the answer

cta.label: Call to action
cta.description: A centred statement with two buttons

gallery.label: Gallery

card-grid.label: Card grid

image.label: Image

contact.label: Contact form

article.label: Article
article.description: Title, summary, image and body text

docs-content.label: Docs page

headline.label: Headline

case-quote.label: Pull quote

case-credits.label: Credits

case-next.label: Next case
